sections.content: Negative commands are formed from the 'yo' form of the present tense (with opposite endings), so verbs with irregular 'yo' forms keep that irregularity in negative commands:

sections.title: Irregular Negative Commands (tú)
rows: ¡No pongas los pies ahí! (Don't put your feet there!)

items.spanish: ¡No vayas solo por esa calle oscura!
items.english: Don't go alone down that dark street!

items.spanish: ¡No tengas miedo, todo va a salir bien!
items.english: Don't be afraid, everything will go well!
